description: Retrieval gold labels (qrels) over the wiki_corpus. Each query names the one relevant note. Queries are NOT pre-bucketed — run_search auto-classifies each as 'lexical' (the relevant note shares vocabulary with the query) or 'semantic' (zero shared content terms, so only meaning-based matching can find it). The semantic bucket is exactly what vector embeddings would help with; its size + the keyword recall on it drive the vector decision.

queries.q: hungarian atalanyado tax gross up formula
q3 pricing retainer bet on mrr
avoid overwhelming a server with simultaneous reconnect storms
